{"summary": "`median()` in `src/stats.js` now gives the right answer for these inputs. `npm test` passes all 4 tests.

There were two bugs:
- **Sorting:** `.sort()` with no arguments sorts numbers as text, so `[10, 9, 2]` came out as `[10, 2, 9]` and the median was 2 instead of 9. It now sorts by numeric value (`(a, b) => a - b`).
- **Even-length lists:** it returned the upper of the two middle values instead of their average. `[4, 1, 3, 2]` now gives `2.5`.

I also made an empty list return `undefined` on purpose. I added tests for the even-length, number-sorting and empty-list cases in `test/stats.test.js`."}
